block.forgemark.hearth.desc: Set it over a campfire, lava or magma. Right-click with an ingot to heat it, and again with an empty hand to take it out once it glows.
block.forgemark.forging_anvil.desc: Lay down the tool, weapon or armour, add its hot ingot, and strike with a smithing hammer when the marker is in the zone. Five strikes, then quench in a water cauldron.
item.forgemark.smithing_hammer.desc: Strikes the forging anvil. Sneak while striking to skip the timing for a higher ingot cost.
forgemark.tooltip.off: Tempering bonuses are turned off here
forgemark.anvil.needs_item: Lay down something to temper first
forgemark.anvil.needs_ingot: Add a hot ingot that repairs it
forgemark.anvil.reheat: The ingot has gone dim. Heat it again.
forgemark.anvil.no_timing_ingots: Skipping the timing costs %s ingots in all
forgemark.anvil.forged: %s is now %s. Quench it in water, or let it cool.
forgemark.anvil.kept: %s keeps its %s temper: this one came out worse
commands.forgemark.unknown_tier: There's no tier called "%s": try rough, standard, fine, superior or masterwork
advancements.forgemark.root.title: Forgemark
advancements.forgemark.root.description: Temper the gear you already have for a small, lasting edge
advancements.forgemark.into_the_fire.des: Set a hearth over a campfire, lava or magma and heat an ingot in it
advancements.forgemark.tempered.title: Tempered
advancements.forgemark.tempered.descript: Lay a tool, weapon or piece of armour on a forging anvil with its hot ingot and strike it five times
advancements.forgemark.quenched.title: Hiss
advancements.forgemark.quenched.descript: Dip a freshly forged piece in a water cauldron while it still glows
advancements.forgemark.fine_work.title: A Steady Hand
advancements.forgemark.fine_work.descrip: Earn a Fine temper or better: every strike in the zone
advancements.forgemark.masterwork.title: Masterwork
advancements.forgemark.masterwork.descri: Earn a Masterwork temper, with your name on it
advancements.forgemark.patient_way.title: The Patient Way
advancements.forgemark.patient_way.descr: Sneak while striking to skip the timing, for an extra ingot
forgemark.jade.hearth.cold: Needs a campfire, lava or magma underneath
